tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the sites the user saved logins for (titles and domains only, never usernames or passwords). The user approves this once per session in LocalGateKeys. Use it to find the site to pass to request_login.

query.description: Optional text to filter titles and domains.

tools.name: request_login
tools.description: Ask the user to approve one sign-in to a site. The user must click Approve once in LocalGateKeys; nothing you write can approve it. Returns a grant id that is valid for 5 minutes, for one fill, only on the exact sign-in host and logins the user approved, and 'method': 'password' (fill_login fills it) or 'passkey' (no password is filled; use the site's passkey sign-in, which the user confirms in LocalGateKeys).

site.description: The sign-in page's host or URL, for example login.example.com; a bare domain means the hosts its saved logins are for.

purpose.description: Why you need to sign in, shown to the user verbatim.

tools.name: fill_login
tools.description: Offer the approved login on the site's sign-in page in the user's browser. Call it with the grant from request_login while the sign-in page is open; the user must click the LocalGateKeys icon in the sign-in field and pick the login within 60 seconds. The result says only whether the page took the grant and does not contain the password, but the password is written into the page, where the page and browser automation can read it. With a passkey grant it fills nothing and waits up to 60 seconds for the site's passkey sign-in, then says whether it went through.

tab_hint.description: Optional: the page title or URL you opened.
